title: 第1538章 两个条件第1537章 不公平的规则
content_zh:
不过要说绝对不公平，倒也没那么夸张，一则是这晋级的二百个虎组选手就没有弱者，至少在顷刻转瞬境界的修士中都是顶尖的存在。
能培养出这样的高手，一般也都是些大势力。
而这二百人来自于八十多个不同的城池，这些城池中又有不同的势力分布，不一定上下一心，甚至许多势力还可能是势不两立的存在。
所以说这虽然是一场大鱼吃小鱼的游戏，但是，“鱼儿”很多。
就好比长卿所在的青芜城，最终晋级的也不过是他，孙墨河，骨幽姬三人而已。
这三个人理论上就算是个小团体了，而在这二百人中，像他们这样的小团体，乃至更小的团体，可能数都数不过来。
如此算来，真正能利用自身势力获取巨大优势的人，其实不算多，枯荣宗虽然表面上被长卿玩弄于股掌之中，实际上却算得上是整个八埏界域的一流宗门，是有尊者级别的强者坐镇的。
像是枯荣宗这样的势力，也不过是有三人晋级，其他小势力可想而知。
规则公布之后，留给虎组选手大概半个时辰的准备时间，说的好听，实际上就是变相地给他们留出了商议对策，互相结盟，利益交换的时间。
长卿对此倒是无感，莫说他新得了万毒，对自身的实力本就非常自信，就算他真不慎阴沟翻船，还有魏九凤亲自来给他兜底。
倒是孙墨河急匆匆地离开了，估计应该是去找周枫商议对策。
没过多久，孙墨河便赶了回来，先是和骨幽姬说了些什么，而后两人一同来到了长卿面前。
“林师弟。”
孙墨河开门见山。
“我们刚刚去和少宗主商议过了，不知道你可否愿意出手帮忙。”
长卿没有回答，只是抬眼瞥向他。
“喂，你什么意思。”
骨幽姬沉不住气，见长卿态度轻蔑，一时气恼道。
“这规则明摆着就是要我们互相合作才行，你不依附我们，难道想靠自己一个人杀出重围么。”
“无妨。”

孙墨河抬手，打断了还想继续说下去的骨幽姬。
“少宗主已经料到林师弟不会轻易出手相助，所以他给林师弟开了两个条件。”
这次长卿并没有急着拒绝，而是淡淡道。
“说说看。”
“我们枯荣宗这边能联合的势力一共有四家，是绝对会听从我们命令，无条件帮我们行事的，分别是风云城的玄元门一人，落星城温家一人，墨石林石家一人，灵榫城木枢阁两人，算上我和骨幽姬，一共有七人。”
content_en:
But to say that it is absolutely unfair is not that exaggerated. Firstly, there is no weak among the 200 tiger group players who have been promoted. At least they are top-notch beings among the monks in the instantaneous realm.
Those who can cultivate such masters are usually from powerful forces.
And these 200 people come from more than 80 different cities, and there are different distributions of forces in these cities. They may not necessarily be united, and many forces may even be irreconcilable.
So although this is a game of big fish eating small fish, there are a lot of "fish".
Just like the Qingwu City where Changqing is located, the only ones who were promoted in the end were him, Sun Mohe, and Gu Youji.
In theory, these three people can be considered a small group, and among these two hundred people, small groups like them, or even smaller groups, may not be able to be counted.
Calculated in this way, there are not many people who can really use their own power to gain huge advantages. Although Kurong Sect is manipulated by Chang Qing on the surface, it is actually considered to be the first-class sect in the entire Baguo Realm, with powerful men at the level of venerables sitting in charge.
For a force like the Kurong Sect, only three people have been promoted, and other small forces can be imagined.
After the rules were announced, the Tiger Team players were left with about half an hour to prepare. To put it nicely, it was actually a disguised form of time for them to discuss countermeasures, form alliances, and exchange interests.
Chang Qing was indifferent to this, not to mention that he was newly infected with ten thousand poisons, and he was very confident in his own strength. Even if he accidentally capsized, Wei Jiufeng would personally come to tell him the truth.
On the other hand, Sun Mohe left in a hurry, probably to discuss countermeasures with Zhou Feng.
Not long after, Sun Mohe rushed back. First he said something to Gu Youji, and then the two of them came to Chang Qing together.
"Junior Brother Lin."
Sun Mohe got straight to the point.
"We just went to discuss it with the young sect master. I wonder if you are willing to help."
Chang Qing didn't answer, just raised his eyes and glanced at him.
"Hey, what do you mean?"
Gu Youji couldn't keep her anger, and seeing Chang Qing's contemptuous attitude, she said angrily.
"The rules clearly require us to cooperate with each other. If you don't rely on us, do you want to fight your way out of the siege on your own?"
"It doesn't matter."
Sun Mohe raised his hand and interrupted Gu Youji who wanted to continue speaking.
"Young Sect Leader has already expected that Junior Brother Lin will not help easily, so he made two conditions for Junior Brother Lin."
This time Chang Qing did not refuse in a hurry, but said calmly.
"Tell me about it."
"We, the Kurong Sect, have a total of four forces that can be united. They will definitely obey our orders and help us unconditionally. They are one person from the Xuanyuan Sect in Fengyun City, one person from the Wen Family in Luo Xing City, one person from the Shi Family in Mo Stone Forest, and two people from Mu Shu Pavilion in Linggu City. Counting me and Gu Youji, there are seven people in total."
